about.text: Kheer is a sweet rice pudding of the Indian subcontinent, made by boiling milk, sugar or jaggery and rice together and flavoured with cardamom, saffron, nuts and dried fruit. Its name comes from Sanskrit kshira, milk, and it is a staple temple offering.
